title: [Bug] Claude Code is not working since Sept 30 | Anthropic API Error: Unexpected Usage Policy Violation Blocking Existing Session
body:
**Bug Description**
See I have been working with Claude and same files have been worked by Claude since last 50-60 days


Today, I have scheduled for a version release and at morning (IST) - So many changes were done. During the last phase of that - Claude got stuck with a json error(corrupted ? - if its corrupted, claude only edited and added the content too)

I waiited for 6hrs. 

Evening -i tried again - thinking it might be a glitch in claude nand would get fixed. DIdnt get ficxded.

Tried multiple session restarts, 

Tried open new claude and used /resume - it didnt worked

Deleted claude cache and /tmp content of claude as per claude web suggestion.

Finally and nothinhg worked, I tried a new session - its double work as I have to start over and my plans have to be changed and blogs have been  moved out now

Now, it keeps saying below error

  ⎿ API Error: Claude Code is unable to respond to this request, which appears to
    violate our Usage Policy (https://www.anthropic.com/legal/aup). Please double
    press esc to edit your last message or start a new session for Claude Code to
    assist with a different task.


Chat with claude help bot in website told that there is a ongoing issue. I waited . WHen the status of that error ius shown as fixed. I tried again.

Still same issue. I cna see other people also reporting teh same in twitter. 

I  am, a max user. Atleastr value for money.

And please show genuine errorr message at-least - instead of this policy violation - How can that happen - when claude itself had generated the readme file content?

**Environment Info**
- Platform: darwin
- Terminal: iTerm.app
- Version: 1.0.102
- Feedback ID: 6b82c8d2-86a5-4b28-b8a0-faa5d2c546fb
